newsitem.title: UK: Abbey Natl ups variable mortgage to 7.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Abbey Natl ups variable mortgage to 7.95 pct.

text.p: Britain's Abbey National Plc said on Friday it had increased its variable mortgage rate by 0.35 percent to 7.95 percent. The bank said it would also raise its savings rates.

The move followed the Bank of England's decision to raise official rates to 6.5 percent from 6.25 percent. The rise in the borrowing rate would be effective from June 10 for new borrowers and July 1 for existing customers, an Abbey National spokesman told Reuters.

"This modest rise in rates is the first since the Bank of England was given control of monetary policy and has been widely anticipated by the market," Andrew Pople, Abbey's retail managing director for retail, said.
Pople said the level of the increase was "unlikely to damage the strong and steady recovery seen in the housing market since the middle of 1996".
